subject: Access request: pen test detail delivery & redaction criteria
messages:
From: Alex Benton <abenton@acmecloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen test report + exec summary (SOC 2 / SIG follow-up)

Hi Evelyn / Karthik,

Thanks again for walking us through the SOC 2 evidence last week. As part of our SIG and procurement review we need the most recent penetration test artifacts so our engineering and security teams can validate remediation and map findings back to our CAIQ answers. Specifically: 

- Executive summary (high level findings, scope, test dates)
- Full pen test report with vulnerability descriptions and CVSS where available
- A short remediation status matrix (remediation owner, ETA, risk posture)

Our security policy requires a mutual NDA for sharing detailed findings that contain repro steps. If you can share a redacted report or an exec summary immediately, we can get that into our compliance review while legal circulates the NDA. If you prefer, we can sign your mutual NDA — we are comfortable with redaction of customer-identifying data / internal IP addresses.

Also: are you able to provide the list of affected components (service names / versions) and whether any findings require customer coordination (external-facing credentials, API keys, etc.)?

Can you confirm what you can provide without an executed NDA and an estimated date for full access after a signed agreement?

Thanks,
Alex
Security Program Manager
Acme Cloud Platforms
security@acmecloud.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Benton <abenton@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary (SOC 2 / SIG follow-up)

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the clear list. Short answers up front: we can provide an executive summary and a redacted report without an executed NDA; detailed repro steps and the full un-redacted findings require a mutual NDA or secure-viewer session.

Proposed approach:
- Today/tomorrow: we will send a redacted executive summary (no repro steps, hostnames replaced with tokens, no customer-identifying data).
- With signed NDA: we can either (a) provide a redacted full report (technical details + CVSS, repro steps removed) or (b) grant time-limited access to a secure viewer session where your engineers can review repro steps under viewer restrictions (no download, watermarked).

Redaction boundaries we typically apply:
- Remove full hostnames/IPs and replace with internal tokens (e.g., svc-db-01)
- Strip any customer names or third-party tenant identifiers
- Remove raw logs that contain PII / session tokens (we can provide sanitized excerpts)

I’m copying Marissa (legal) to propose a mutual NDA and Karthik (infosec) to confirm the secure viewer option and the remediation matrix format. I’ll attach our suggested NDA draft for your review.

Attachment: Redwood-Mutual-NDA-for-PT-draft-20270402.pdf (draft)

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0192

From: Alex Benton <abenton@acmecloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gina Torres <gina.torres@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary (SOC 2 / SIG follow-up)

Evelyn / Marissa / Karthik — thanks, that workflow sounds good. We reviewed the draft NDA and have routed it for signature. Attached is a signed copy from our side.

Couple quick clarifications while legal finishes:
- Can you include CVSS scores in the redacted report? We need those for our internal risk scoring.
- For findings that reference externally routable endpoints, can you flag them so we know if there's customer coordination required?
- ETA: our compliance deadline for initial SIG evidence is 2027-04-09 — is that feasible for an exec summary + redacted report?

Attached: Signed_NDA_Acme-Redwood_20270403.pdf

If you can confirm the CVSS inclusion and an access date, we’ll prioritize the review.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Security Program Manager
Acme Cloud Platforms

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Benton <abenton@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary (SOC 2 / SIG follow-up)

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround on the NDA. We received the signed copy this morning and have finished the redaction pass. Per your asks: we included CVSS scores in the redacted report and flagged externally routable findings that may require customer coordination.

What we are delivering now (attachments):
- ACME-Redwood-PT-ExecSummary-redacted-20270405.pdf — executive summary, scope, high-level remediation status
- ACME-Redwood-PT-Redacted-Report-20270405.pdf — full report with technical details and CVSS scores; hostnames/IPS and customer identifiers replaced with tokens; repro steps are summarized but raw steps are omitted

Remediation status (summary table in exec summary):
- RCE in analytics ingestion: In progress — patch deployed to canary (owner: infra-team, ETA: 2027-04-12)
- OAuth token leakage (third-party integration): Completed — revoked keys and rotated secrets (owner: integrations, Completed 2027-03-28)
- Missing MFA on admin console: Planned — rolling rollout starting 2027-04-10 (owner: identity, ETA: 2027-04-20)

Next steps/options for full evidence review:
- Secure viewer session (we can provision a one-week session for your engineers). Viewer is watermarked and download-disabled.
- On-prem/escrow handoff under a custodian agreement for highly sensitive evidence (if required).

If you want the secure viewer, I’ll ask our ops team to schedule it and send the session link (we’ll need a list of reviewer emails and an IP allowlist).

Let us know if the redacted attachments meet your needs for the SIG export; happy to follow up with a short sync to walk through the remediation table.

Attachments: ACME-Redwood-PT-ExecSummary-redacted-20270405.pdf; ACME-Redwood-PT-Redacted-Report-20270405.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infosec Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
(On behalf of the Customer Security & Legal team)
